Earth→jupiter→europa: 99% cells feasible. ∆v = heliocentric Earth→jupiter departure + europa-orbit insertion (arrival v∞ carried down the host well, µ_host then µ_moon; moon radius from its sidereal period via Kepler). Two-body teaching estimate — the honest direct-capture upper bound; real missions use gravity-assist tours to reduce the moon leg.
